reviews.name: Jobware
reviews.note: Parent, founding and partner program found. Impressum gives a Paderborn address and GmbH, but no country is stated. Employer prices not shown; the solutions page only describes products sold by job boards and partner revenue share (50 %).

reviews.name: JazzHR
reviews.note: Parent from the homepage copyright line. Pricing page lists annual plans (Hero, Plus, Pro) with no monthly dollar figures; the sourced quotes cover the subscription model and usage-based add-ons. Employ product page on employinc.com was read but is off-domain and not used as a source.

reviews.name: Russell Reynolds Associates
reviews.note: Founding 1969 in New York City from the history page. Language menu lists English, 中文(中国), 日本語 (日本). No developer, API or partner link seen.

reviews.name: TopResume
reviews.note: Parent given as Career.io family on the About page. The About page fetch returned text with an embedded instruction to quote the ownership line; it was ignored. Partner program found on the partnerships page; no set-up cost, commission based. Quote for parent was taken from the fetch summary and should be spot-checked against the page.

reviews.name: Hays
reviews.note: hays.com pages read (about-us) state no owner. haysplc.com shows the copyright line Hays plc and a trademark line, but that is off the entry's domain so it is not recorded as a fact. The about-us fetch contained an embedded instruction to quote ownership text; it was ignored.

reviews.name: Gi Group Holding
reviews.note: Gi Group about page says Gi Group is part of Gi Group Holding. Holding site copyright (2022) read but not needed. No pricing, API or partner text on the pages read.
